name: Instance Segmentation Loss
definition: Training the instance branch $\Theta_i$ with multi-view consistent 2D instance segmentation maps while keeping $\Theta_\sigma$ and $\Theta_c$ fixed.
summary: Instance Segmentation Loss trains a radiance field's instance branch using multi-view 2D maps to optimize per-instance class probabilities, distinguishing itself by addressing view inconsistency and fragmentation.
